-MRG 2026/01/22 Changes made to bypass Subframe locks to make repairs
-Changes were made in FB2708 Net 16
-Drive Free bit added to Subframe locked logic

ContentBlocks.TextContent: <FlowDocument FontSize="14" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" Background="#FF1A1A1A" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" ColumnWidth="Auto" IsOptimalParagraphEnabled="False" PageWidth="Auto" PageHeight="Auto" PagePadding="5,0,5,0" IsHyphenationEnabled="False" AllowDrop="True" NumberSubstitution.CultureSource="User" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">-If the Subrame lock signal is lost while the Stacker is moving, place the Stacker in Maintenance. Then select the Maintenance/Drive Free tabs, enable Bypass Interlocks button and clear the blue flashing light. Jog the Subframe to a level it can be repaired, once repaired turn off maintenance. Turning maintenance off will clear the bypass automatically. </Paragraph></FlowDocument>
ContentBlocks.PlainTextContent: -If the Subrame lock signal is lost while the Stacker is moving, place the Stacker in Maintenance. Then select the Maintenance/Drive Free tabs, enable Bypass Interlocks button and clear the blue flashing light. Jog the Subframe to a level it can be repaired, once repaired turn off maintenance. Turning maintenance off will clear the bypass automatically.
